result.instructions: HCMC only; Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh. Resolve ambiguous addresses before planning. Preserve verdict.estimate, access versus legality, evidence tiers, citations and caveats. Unknown exit/flood is not a pass; Unverified legality is not permission. Read-only cached-area engine tools, no LLM or crawl. No transport sessions are issued.

tools.name: tim_dia_diem
tools.description: Tìm địa chỉ/địa điểm TP.HCM; phải hỏi lại khi có nhiều kết quả. Search HCMC addresses/POIs, up to three coordinate candidates; resolve ambiguity before planning. Example: {"query":"Hẻm 113/4 Võ Duy Ninh, Bình Thạnh"}.

tools.name: lap_ke_hoach
tools.description: Lập kế hoạch đến đầy đủ: ước tính xe vào, độ tin cậy, dừng/đỗ, đi bộ, đường ra, ngập, luật và nguồn. Full arrival plan: preserve verdict.estimate, access versus legal status, stop points, walking, exit, flood, citations, evidence tiers and caveats. Unknown is not safe; physical access does not authorize stopping. Uses existing cached areas only; cannot build or crawl. Example: {"lat":10.792106,"lon":106.716661,"label":"Hẻm 113/4 Võ Duy Ninh","vehicle_id":"toyota-fortuner","arrive_at":"2026-10-17T18:00:00+07:00","dwell_min":120,"intent":"park"}.

lat.description: HCMC service-area latitude; use coordinates returned by tim_dia_diem.

vehicle_id.description: Catalogue ID or recognized model alias, e.g. toyota-fortuner, Fortuner, class-m.

arrive_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp with timezone, e.g. 2026-10-17T18:00:00+07:00. No forecast beyond source coverage.

tools.name: kiem_tra_xe_vao_hem

tools.name: danh_sach_xe
tools.description: Danh mục mẫu xe và nhóm kích thước XS–XL; kích thước mét và nguồn tra cứu. Vehicle catalogue and conservative size classes; dimensions in metres. Source references resolve in sources. Mirror estimates and class envelopes are assumptions, not surveyed clearance. Example: {}.

tools.name: muc_trieu
tools.description: Xem triều Phú An trong tối đa 36 giờ, có nguồn; không ngoại suy khi thiếu bản tin. Tide extrema and alarm thresholds, at most 36 hours; missing_points means unknown, not no flood. Example: {"start":"2026-10-17T12:00:00+07:00","hours":24}.

start.description: ISO 8601 timestamp with timezone, e.g. 2026-10-17T18:00:00+07:00. No forecast beyond source coverage.
